reported_success.location: General discussion, Part 2 assessment, cached text line 108
reported_success.quote: In Part 2 of our study, our replication results of Johnson et al. (2002) were inconsistent with the original findings. Unlike the original study, we found framing effects, yet we found no evidence for default effects.

notes: Both cached full texts were verified by their titles and target study descriptions. Original supplied locator p. 8 does not contain Experiment 2 results in this published pagination: Table 2 is on printed p. 10 and the requested tests are on printed p. 12. Replication supplied cache has no page boundaries; exact section and cache line cited. Selected the Results narrative coefficient and its paired p value without conversion. Replication Table 7 reports different framing values (Model 1 OR = 27.27, p < .001; Model 2 OR = 15.30, p < .001) from the narrative OR = 15.61. Authors characterize the replication framing finding as inconsistent with the original, hence the reported narrative verdict failed; this characterization conflicts with the original paper, which prints a significant Frame test (t = 2.56, p < .02). The narrative verdict is retained as an author claim, not a statistical inference.
